name: Atelier Playa Mujeres

address.street: Prolongación Bonampak S/N Mz 1 Lote RTH4

insider_take: This adults-only sanctuary sits on pristine Playa Mujeres, where Caribbean waters meet powdery white sand just 35 minutes from Cancun's buzz yet worlds away from the crowds.
whats_special: Atelier Playa Mujeres features an exclusive beach location where sea turtles nest seasonally, plus it's perfectly positioned near the Mesoamerican Reef - the second-largest coral reef system in the world. The resort's culinary program includes a rooftop restaurant with 360-degree views and access to championship golf at the adjacent Greg Norman-designed course.
pro_tip: Book dinner at the rooftop restaurant during sunset - the panoramic views stretch from Isla Mujeres to the Cancun skyline, and it's one of the highest dining venues in the region.
dont_miss: Take the complimentary ferry to nearby Isla Mujeres to explore Punta Sur's sculpture garden and lighthouse, or snorkel at the underwater museum MUSA, where over 500 life-sized sculptures create an otherworldly diving experience in crystal-clear Caribbean waters.
pros: Adults-only luxury resort with sophisticated ambiance
Pristine beachfront location on Playa Mujeres
Multiple gourmet dining venues and premium bars
cons: Adults-only policy excludes families with children
